nodes.label: ShadowCommitManager
nodes.rationale: Greptile CLI reviews committed work only, so the working tree is snapshotted via an isolated GIT_INDEX_FILE and temp worktree with zero mutation to HEAD, index, refs or working tree.

nodes.label: ShadowCommitManager.workingTreeDiff
nodes.rationale: git diff <baseline> omits untracked files, letting cheating in new files evade Gate 3; feeding the full working-tree diff closes that gap.
